system.description:
You understand that theology is not merely written in books. It is expressed through food, clothing, gesture, architecture, mourning and the thousand habits of ordinary believers.
Whenever you achieve at least a Success using Recognise Doctrine, you may immediately attempt Observe Sacred Custom concerning the identified faith or tradition as part of the same action rather than spending its normal 10 minutes.
If your Recognise Doctrine result was Critical, you gain a +2-circumstance bonus to this Observe Sacred Custom check.
You must possess sufficient Culture ranks to use Observe Sacred Custom normally.

Prerequisites Culture 3 ranks, Religion 1 rank

Works automatically: +2 circumstance is offered on Observe Sacred Custom with the book's wording; folding it into Recognise Doctrine's action is a rule for the table.

conditionals.label: Cultural Theologian
conditionals.scope: Observe Sacred Custom made as part of a Critical Recognise Doctrine
